explanation: Ran ./eta/build/exclurad against ./eta/input.dat, which already contained the requested kinematics (W=1.5753 GeV, Q2=0.3 GeV2, cos(theta*)=-0.527586, phi*=36/72/108 deg) with the standard CLAS12 eta-channel settings (model=3 EtaMAID, bmom=6.53 GeV, lepton=1 electron, ivec=1 recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2 inelasticity cut). W=1.5753 GeV is safely above the ep->e'p(eta) threshold (~1.486 GeV), so the kinematics are physical. The code converged cleanly for all three phi points (internal born-cross-section consistency test ratio = 1.00 at each point). delta and sigma_born were read directly from radtot.dat (columns 6 and 7: sigar(1)/sibar(1) and sibar(1) for the unpolarized structure functions, ipol=1), reported exactly as EXCLURAD printed them with no rounding. sigma_born is the unpolarized Born five-fold differential cross section in EXCLURAD's native code units (nb/GeV^4, consistent with sigma_born values reported by exclurad for this kinematic regime).
